wish: someone should make a progress bar for the back seat so kids can see if we're there yet
spec:
A cartoon road scene where a little car drives from home to grandma's, the beach, the zoo, a city or a campsite, with hills and trees sliding past and signs at 25%, halfway and almost there.
A parent taps Set up trip, enters minutes or an arrival time, picks the destination and optional stops; the kids read the big percent and the time left in minutes or cartoons.
It follows the clock only, not GPS or traffic; at 100% it throws confetti and says We're here.
notes: Offline; follows the device clock only.
